items.title: LinkedIn profile summary (roles + themes)
items.embedding_text: Professional summary: Senior architect / product-engineering leader spanning AI agent platforms and aerospace operations software. Based in the Atlanta, Georgia area (remote-capable). Themes: building full-stack systems end-to-end; architecting model-agent loops; retrieval + context management; integrating LLMs and vector databases; delivering production software under high-stakes constraints (safety, certification, regulatory frameworks).

items.title: Magic Data — Senior Architect, Core AI (Sep 2022–Present)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: Magic Data — Senior Architect, Core AI (part-time), Sep 2022–Present, Atlanta GA (remote). Leads development of an AI-driven platform that helps users become instant experts on their own data. System uses foundation models to generate, execute, and iterate on custom data pipelines from natural language prompts. Focus: architecture + implementation of the core model-agent loop so users can describe data objectives conversationally and receive working, executable code in real time. Works across the agent framework stack: prompt-based behavior design, context/retrieval management (Chroma + MongoDB), LLM integration, and responses that can be debugged/refined in an embedded code editor.

items.title: Wisk — Lead Product Engineer (Oct 2019–Present)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: Wisk — Lead Product Engineer, Oct 2019–Present, Greater Atlanta Area. Leads development + integration of software platforms powering air carrier operations for a certified autonomous passenger aircraft program. Oversees cross-functional delivery across fleet management, maintenance, crew proficiency, dispatching, and vertiport automation; aligns operational + certification objectives with business outcomes. Started in avionics verification (DO-178) then moved into operational software. Current focus: integrating complex microservices and platforms via RESTful APIs to support rapid iteration amid evolving aircraft capabilities and regulatory frameworks. Collaborates with systems engineering, airworthiness/ops certification teams, and product leadership.

items.title: Stackfolio — Senior Software Engineer (Jun 2018–Oct 2019)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: Stackfolio (acquired by $JKHY) — Senior Software Engineer, Jun 2018–Oct 2019, Greater Atlanta Area. Product development, architecture, and infrastructure management for a marketplace + trade tool for banking/institutional whole loan, debt, and asset trading. Supported full-stack product technologies including Python, Django, MongoDB, and Google Cloud Platform.

items.title: FIX Health — Software Architect (Dec 2015–Jan 2018)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: FIX : Fitness Interactive Experience — Software Architect, Dec 2015–Jan 2018, Greater Atlanta Area. Planned and implemented infrastructure, personnel, web-based SaaS development, and corporate strategy for a gaming + corporate wellness platform. Built and maintained platforms, implemented RESTful architecture, and optimized transactional database schemas.

items.title: ImagineAir — CTO, Head of Product (Nov 2009–Jan 2018)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: ImagineAir — CTO, Head of Product, Nov 2009–Jan 2018, Greater Atlanta Area (on-site). Led technology + product strategy for a Cirrus-based Part 135 air taxi operator. Designed and delivered scheduling automation + route optimization to solve the empty-leg inefficiency problem; built an automated, airline-style point-of-sale reservation system for on-demand flights. Evolved software for maintenance workflows, crew proficiency tracking, fleet management, and flight operations—reducing costs and scaling operations from 3 aircraft and ~$500K annual revenue to 18+ aircraft and $10M+ annually. Licensed reservation, revenue-yield, and fleet-management software to other operators/booking agencies; helped establish Sabre-like inventory consolidation for Part 135.

Taught students front-end and back-end application development (including ReactJS and PHP) plus a wide range of web coding languages, practices, frameworks, and core concepts.

items.title: NFL Network — Full Stack Developer (2013–2014)
items.embedding_text: Work experience: NFL Network — Full Stack Developer, 2013–2014, Greater Atlanta Area. Developed a standalone network affiliate portal (LAMP-based) enabling worldwide receiver hardware tracking and NFL Network blackout management.

items.title: Encompass Digital Media — Senior Product Engineer (Sep 2001–Nov 2010)

Lead developer on CMS projects including standalone cloud software systems for 3rd Army Public Affairs, NBC Universal Central Casting, Discovery Channel/Networks, and the NFL Network.
